slug: 2025-01-17 Zambia Advances Digital ID System with MOSIP Training for Healthcare Integration

ZMB.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
No identity number at birth is stated.

facts.fact: ID Tech reports that SMART Zambia developers were trained on MOSIP by IHM's team, with the programme aimed at letting Zambian developers independently manage and maintain the platform.

ZMB.note: Only a health record system integration is stated, not a public register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: ID Tech reports that Zambia is preparing to launch an open-source eKYC system based on the MOSIP framework, funded by a $100 million World Bank grant through DZAP.
